historical_description: PROS provides software solutions that optimize shopping and selling experiences for both business-to-business ... companies across industry verticals in more than 80 countries. filing_description: PROS provides software solutions that optimize shopping and selling experiences for both business-to-business ... companies across industry verticals in more than 80 countries. rationale: The 2024 Form 10-K documents a SaaS business whose central promise is AI-driven pricing and revenue optimization, backed by decades of data-science work, neural networks and reinforcement learning. Removing the models would materially change the product being sold.
counterevidence_notes: The portfolio has adjacent workflow/commerce modules, but the key pricing and airline revenue products rely on AI-driven prediction and optimization.

description_text: New Relic is a leading “all-in-one” observability platform that enables our customers to plan, build, deploy, and operate their critical digital infrastructure by harnessing the power of data. Our observability platform combines metrics, events, logs, traces, and other telemetry data with our proprietary stack of analytical tools to rapidly generate actionable, fact-based insights.
historical_description: New Relic is a leading “all-in-one” observability platform that enables our customers to plan, build, deploy, and operate their critical digital infrastructure by harnessing the power of data. filing_description: New Relic is a leading “all-in-one” observability platform that enables our customers to plan, build, deploy, and operate their critical digital infrastructure by harnessing the power of data. Our observability platform combines metrics, events, logs, traces, and other telemetry data with our proprietary stack of analytical tools to rapidly generate actionable, fact-based insights.
rationale: Pre-deal filings and product announcements document ML-based anomaly detection and AIOps, but the company’s core product remains a broad observability platform rather than a model-dependent AI product. AI positioning is documented more than 12 months before the announcement.
counterevidence_notes: There is proprietary ML functionality, although the overall platform remains useful without it and AI-specific revenue is not disclosed.

description_text: Verint Systems Inc. (together with its consolidated subsidiaries, “Verint”, the “Company”, “we”, “us”, and “our”, unless the context indicates otherwise) is a leader in customer experience (“CX”) automation. The world’s most iconic brands – including more than 80 of the Fortune 100 companies – use the Verint Open Platform and our team of AI-powered bots to deliver tangible AI business outcomes across the enterprise.

filing_description: Verint Systems Inc. The world’s most iconic brands – including more than 80 of the Fortune 100 companies – use the Verint Open Platform and our team of AI-powered bots to deliver tangible AI business outcomes across the enterprise.
rationale: Da Vinci AI and the AI-powered bot portfolio are platform-level capabilities documented before the announcement. I code the overall target more conservatively at level 1 because its broader suite also includes workforce engagement, analytics and other customer-engagement applications that do not all depend on AI.
counterevidence_notes: The strongest counterevidence is Da Vinci AI at platform core and the broad AI-bot portfolio; however, the company’s overall application suite remains diversified, so this pass treats AI as an important enabling layer.

description_text: We have pioneered a new category of software, the Intelligent Data Management Cloud, or IDMC. We deliver innovation-led products powered by the industry leading artificial intelligence
historical_description: We have pioneered a new category of software, the Intelligent Data Management Cloud, or IDMC. We deliver innovation-led products powered by the industry leading artificial intelligence
filing_description: We have pioneered a new category of software, the Intelligent Data Management Cloud, or IDMC. We deliver innovation-led products powered by the industry leading artificial intelligence
rationale: A 2017 company announcement documents CLAIRE as a proprietary metadata-driven AI technology using ML. However, Informatica sold a broad data-management platform that would remain useful without CLAIRE, and AI-specific revenue was not reported.
counterevidence_notes: The technical asset and historical-persistence tests pass; the product-dependence and AI-specific revenue tests do not.

counterevidence_notes: The platform uses ML for insight and threat detection; data ingestion, search, logging and security analytics remain core functions that are not dependent on AI.

historical_description: Envestnet, through its subsidiaries, is transforming the way financial advice and insight are delivered.
filing_description: Envestnet, through its subsidiaries, is transforming the way financial advice and insight are delivered.
rationale: The pre-announcement disclosure centers on advisor software, portfolio construction/rebalancing, financial data and analytics. No specific pre-deal ML model or AI-native product was established from the reviewed source, so the conservative intensity is 0.
counterevidence_notes: Data analytics and digital advice are important offerings, but neither proves that the product uses AI/ML in the rubric’s sense.

description_text: Proofpoint is a leading next-generation cybersecurity company that enables primarily large and mid-sized organizations worldwide to protect the way their people work from advanced threats and compliance risks. Our integrated suite of products works together to help organizations build people-centric security and compliance programs.
historical_description: Proofpoint is a leading next-generation cybersecurity company that enables primarily large and mid-sized organizations worldwide to protect the way their people work from advanced threats and compliance risks. filing_description: Proofpoint is a leading next-generation cybersecurity company that enables primarily large and mid-sized organizations worldwide to protect the way their people work from advanced threats and compliance risks. Our integrated suite of products works together to help organizations build people-centric security and compliance programs.
rationale: A September 2020 company release documents a machine-learning risk model, supporting a technical-asset pass and AI-enabled intensity. The larger product suite is not fundamentally model-dependent, and the documented feature is too recent for the 12-month persistence test.
counterevidence_notes: ML materially improves detection and prioritization, yet the company remains a broad security/compliance vendor with no AI-specific revenue split.

description_text: Duck Creek Technologies is the leading cloud-based SaaS provider of core systems for the global property and casualty (P&C) and general insurance industry.

rationale: Duck Creek’s pre-announcement disclosures center on configurable SaaS insurance operations and core systems, not model-based products. References to data insights do not by themselves establish AI, and no qualifying AI asset or revenue evidence was found.
counterevidence_notes: The business is data-rich and supports decision workflows, but the contemporaneous filing does not document proprietary AI/ML as a core offering.

rationale: At the April 2016 announcement date, Cvent was a cloud event/hospitality management platform; the referenced annual report does not document model-dependent products, AI technical assets or AI-linked revenue.
counterevidence_notes: The platform used data and automation, but those are not sufficient evidence of AI/ML under the frozen rubric.

rationale: Pre-deal technical documentation shows vector indexing and AI-application integrations, so AI enabled some use cases and passes persistence. The primary product is still a general-purpose operational database, not an AI model or AI-specific infrastructure platform.
counterevidence_notes: The announcement language mentions AI agents, while the pre-deal release notes show vector search; neither makes the underlying database dependent on ML.

rationale: Historical SEC filings show AI/ML features in data quality and data transformation well before the announcement. However, the central product remains data integration/governance, and the sources do not establish proprietary model infrastructure or AI-specific revenue.
counterevidence_notes: The documented pre-deal AI functionality supports level 1 and persistence; no basis was found for a strict-AI label or a dedicated proprietary model asset.

rationale: The pre-deal product set was BI dashboards and visualization, with Ask Data adding natural-language interaction in February 2019. The feature supports an AI-enabled level, but was too recent to satisfy the rubric’s persistence threshold and does not make the main product model-dependent.
counterevidence_notes: Natural-language querying provides counterevidence to a strict non-AI label, but it was a newly released feature and did not replace the underlying BI product.

Our cloud-based platform of solutions, data analytics, and AI enables efficiency and improves quality throughout clinical development programs by accelerating processes, enhancing decision-making, minimizing operational risk, reducing costs, and transforming trial strategies.
historical_description: Medidata is a global life sciences technology provider, dedicated to improving the way clinical research is designed, conducted, analyzed, and commercialized. filing_description: Medidata is a global life sciences technology provider, dedicated to improving the way clinical research is designed, conducted, analyzed, and commercialized. Our cloud-based platform of solutions, data analytics, and AI enables efficiency and improves quality throughout clinical development programs by accelerating processes, enhancing decision-making, minimizing operational risk, reducing costs, and transforming trial strategies.

counterevidence_notes: The AI/data-insights business may have built on years of data science investment, but no qualifying pre-June-2018 AI-positioning source was established for this coding pass.

description_text: Nuance Communications, Inc. is a technology pioneer and market leader in conversational AI and ambient clinical intelligence.
historical_description: Nuance Communications, Inc. is a technology pioneer and market leader in conversational AI and ambient clinical intelligence.
filing_description: Nuance Communications, Inc. is a technology pioneer and market leader in conversational AI and ambient clinical intelligence.
rationale: Nuance’s revenue-generating product set centered on speech recognition, NLU, conversational interfaces and ambient clinical intelligence; these functions depend on AI models rather than merely adding an assistant to conventional software. Its 2019 and 2020 filings provide pre-announcement evidence of persistence.
counterevidence_notes: Clinical workflow and professional-services elements are also present, and AI subproduct revenue is not separately disclosed; however, model-dependent speech and conversational products define the core.

description_text: Altair Engineering Inc. is a global leader in computational science and artificial intelligence enabling organizations across broad industry segments to drive smarter decisions in an increasingly connected world.
historical_description: Altair Engineering Inc. is a global leader in computational science and artificial intelligence enabling organizations across broad industry segments to drive smarter decisions in an increasingly connected world.
filing_description: Altair Engineering Inc. is a global leader in computational science and artificial intelligence enabling organizations across broad industry segments to drive smarter decisions in an increasingly connected world.
rationale: The FY2023 filing documents dedicated AI/data-science and ML workflow offerings alongside simulation, design and HPC. Because the overall suite is broader than AI and no AI-specific revenue split is documented, intensity is 1.
counterevidence_notes: Altair described itself as an AI leader and had ML/MLOps products, but conventional simulation and HPC remain substantial and independently functional.
